answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 51 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the thread challenge, the terrace audit can replay the dawn history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 4577 identities would post 1644 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
